|gr1= Variables

|descr= Swaps the values of two variables '''passed as [[String]]'''.<br>
Nothing is returned as this function modifies the variables directly.

|s1= [variableName1, variableName2] call [[BIS_fnc_swapVars]]

|p1= variableName1: [[String]]

|p2= variableName2: [[String]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>private _a = 1;
_b = 2;
["_a", "_b"] call BIS_fnc_swapVars;
_a == 2; // true
_b == 1; // true</sqf>

|seealso=
